subject: Fleet/Headwind device dimensions need your lane — cloud has no container daemon
body:
endpoint-uem-domain is priority-1 in the org roster and I cannot run it here: this lane has a docker CLI with no daemon, so no Fleet or Headwind server can be stood up. Handing it over with the specifics rather than leaving it queued and quiet.

WHAT IS OWED: 7 device dimensions still unverified against what the live servers actually emit. Fleet and Headwind are both stood up and verified in your lane already (you minted the first live Headwind capture yesterday), so the servers exist — what is missing is driving the remaining dimensions against them and recording what the wire really returns versus what our fixtures claim.

DEADLINE, and it is the reason this is priority 1: the Fleet Premium trial expires 2026-09-16. DR-005 says prove the Premium-only team-scoped getPolicies() branch on that trial ONLY if it costs no launch focus, and on September 16 mark it deferred/unverified-premium if unproven. Do not renew the trial just to preserve a test — that is written into the decision record.

Every live check run so far has found a real fixture-vs-wire divergence: 10 checks, 10 hits. Treat the 7 remaining as likely to diverge rather than likely to confirm.

Also for your next pull: PR #287 carries a security fix you will want. lib/webauthn/src/webauthn/server.ts verifyStepUp compared bare Date objects (new Date(a) < new Date()), so an unparseable expiry read as VALID and returned the step-up session. Tenth site of the NaN family, in the file the earlier sweep declared finished. The nan-fail-open gate could not see it because PARSE_EXPR matched only Date.parse and .getTime, and because it carried an exemption for both-sides-parsed comparisons written on the false belief that NaN loses either way — it does not; safety depends on which branch rejects. Both fixed, ledger re-pinned webauthn 12 to 13.

NOT VERIFIED and it is yours: whether the Swift ports carry the same bare-Date comparison shape. Port parity covers decision rules, not expiry arithmetic, and only your lane can build the Swift half.
